content: MCP spec 2025-06-18 changelog (primary modelcontextprotocol.io): removed JSON-RPC batching; added structured tool output (structuredContent/outputSchema); OAuth resource-server classification + RFC8707 resource indicators; elicitation; resource links in tool results; MCP-Protocol-Version header required on HTTP; _meta on more types; title field for display names; lifecycle SHOULD->MUST.
